name: OPERATION: IRON FRONT
description: Open-world military game on the 12 km island of Varden. Campaign: 12 missions. Free Roam with your squad, any vehicle and sandbox tools. Battle vs AI: TDM, Domination, Conquest, King of the Hill, CTF, Sector Control, Survival. Online Battle: Team Deathmatch or Domination with the real players in the lot.
